name: Volume Ray Casting with Barycentric Interpolation and Phong Lighting
definition: A volume rendering technique that casts rays from a viewing plane through a 3D voxel grid, sampling voxel values using barycentric interpolation within the unit cube, and accumulating lighting contributions (ambient, diffuse, specular) along the ray path.
summary: This direct volume rendering technique casts parallel rays through a voxel grid, using barycentric interpolation for sampling and Phong shading for lighting, while attenuating rays to simulate absorption without secondary ray tracing.
